change: Grouped internal-training outcome picker with need-level selection and text/scope filters.

browser: Foundation defaults to 29 scoped outcomes grouped under five needs.
Selecting N1 checks its three outcomes; partial selection displays the mixed group state.
Text filtering retains hidden selections and reports how many are outside the filter.
Group clearing while filtered removes only the matching outcome.
Select shown and Clear shown preserve other need selections.
An unmatched search shows a helpful empty state and disables bulk buttons.
Saving while no outcomes are visible retains hidden selected IDs; reopening confirms them.
Remaining plan gaps uses the current planned-coverage results.
Component and legacy saves retain selections and recalculate planned coverage.
Legacy scenario settings still open normally.
Isolated standalone picker works without companion files or console warnings/errors.

limitations: Direct file:// browser opening and native print/PDF layout were not checked in this run.
